content: Hard work is worthless for those that don't believe in themselves.
When people are protecting something truly special to them, they truly can become as strong as they can be.
A lesson without pain is meaningless.
It's not a crime to exist.
Power comes in response to a need, not a desire.
Whatever you lose, you'll find it again. But what you throw away you'll never get back.
If you don't take risks, you can't create a future.
The world isn't perfect. But it's there for us, doing the best it can.
I don't know everything, I just know what I know.
The moment you think of giving up, think of the reason why you held on so long.
Fear is not evil. It tells you what your weakness is.
I'll leave tomorrow's problems to tomorrow's me.
I'm not a hero because I want your approval. I do it because I want to.
People's lives don't end when they die, it ends when they lose faith.
A place where someone still thinks about you is a place you can call home.
